name: branding-notched-hexagon-arrow-logistics-logo
title: Chamfered block symbol with cut-in arrow beside stacked condensed wordmark
whatItIs: A white slide with tiny corner captions and a black logo: a chamfered square mark with a white arrow shape cut into it, next to the two-line name 'OLAN LOGISTIC' in wide bold caps.
whatItMeans: Solid and directional; the box with arrow says parcel in motion.
techniques: Cut an arrow as negative space in a solid box.
Chamfer corners to imply a package.
Stack the name on two lines beside the mark.
Use tiny caps captions to frame.

vocabulary.definition: An arrow formed by empty space.
A brand name set on two lines.
